edits.label: add lang prop + copy object
edits.find:
import { Wallet, CalendarDays, Repeat, MinusCircle } from "@lucide/astro";
---

edits.label: translate income field + province select
edits.find:
<CalculatorField id="grossIncome" label="Gross Annual Income" type="number" required={true} helpText="Your gross salary before deductions (CAD)." />
      <label class="field-label" for="province">Province</label>
      <select id="province" class="field-select">
        <option value="ON">Ontario</option>
        <option value="AB">Alberta</option>
        <option value="BC">British Columbia</option>
      </select>
edits.replace:
<CalculatorField id="grossIncome" label={copy.grossIncomeLabel} type="number" required={true} helpText={copy.grossIncomeHelp} />
      <label class="field-label" for="province">{copy.provinceLabel}</label>
      <select id="province" class="field-select">
        <option value="ON">{copy.ontario}</option>
        <option value="AB">{copy.alberta}</option>
        <option value="BC">{copy.britishColumbia}</option>
      </select>

edits.label: ActionButtons text props
edits.replace: <CalculatorActions calculateId="calculateBtn" resetId="resetBtn" copyId="copyBtn" showCopy={true} calculateText={copy.calculate} resetText={copy.reset} copyText={copy.copy} />
